Fabric & Fit

Built to survive the wash

The piping is the whole product. Here's what it is, and what it isn't.

ElementSpecWhy it matters
Neon-trace pipingBonded electroluminescent-look film, not screen printSurvives 50+ washes without cracking at the seam
Compression knit78% recycled nylon / 22% elastane, 210-250 gsmFour-way stretch that holds shape through supersets
VentilationLaser-cut micro-perforation at ribcage and back panelDumps heat without the mesh-panel see-through
SeamsFlatlock throughout, bonded hems on cropsNo chafe on long sessions, no roll-up overhead
CareCold wash inside out, hang dry, no fabric softenerSoftener coats the film and kills the glow finish
Sizing: compression pieces (Voltcore, Pulse, Gridline) run true to size for a training fit — size down one for full compression. The Nightshift set is cut oversized; size down if you want it fitted.

Positioning

Who this is for

The night trainer

Trains between 7pm and 11pm. Cares that the piping reads on camera and on a dark street. Buys the top first, comes back for the set.

The fit-check poster

Posts the outfit before the workout. Our best organic engine — the product is the content, so the cap and crop lead every creator seed.

The gateway buy

$38-42Caps are the entry SKU. Low-friction first purchase, highest repeat rate, and the piece that puts the wordmark in every UGC frame.

The basket builder

$168The Nightshift set anchors average order value. Merchandise it directly under the compression pieces, never on its own page.
